recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-15105 because the approved capability is present under the later isRecordOfRequest name.
issue_request: FHIR-15105 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution after concerns that merging MedicationStatement.taken into status lost the ability to distinguish patient-reported non-use from whether a medication should remain on the active medication list. The final resolution did not restore MedicationStatement.taken; it said the concern was addressed by adding MedicationRequest reporting and information-source attributes, with other topics split into separate trackers.
initial_application: FHIR-19313 explicitly implemented the seed resolution by adding MedicationRequest.reported and MedicationRequest.informationSource, citing FHIR-15105 as background. Jira records commit 65133c5 for the work, and local history shows the GF 19313 source change adding the reported external-order narrative and the reported/informationSource elements.
additional_context: MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. A later R6 tracker, FHIR-49863, renamed MedicationRequest.reported to MedicationRequest.isRecordOfRequest and clarified that such an instance is a record of a request rather than an actionable request/order. FHIR-19313 is already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-49863 is later context rather than a separate decision in this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current MedicationRequest StructureDefinition defines informationSource and isRecordOfRequest, the MedicationRequest introduction says reported external requests are informational and non-authoritative, and a current example uses both isRecordOfRequest and informationSource. MedicationStatement source remains scoped to reports of medication use/non-use rather than ordering.
